basic_info.description: REDUCED! Unit #1 is now vacant for new owner! This well-cared-for 4-unit corner building reflects true pride of ownership, ideally located directly across from Golden Gate Park and just minutes from Ocean Beach. Enjoy easy access to the N-Judah MUNI line, Irving and Judah Street shops, popular local restaurants, and multiple transit options. Each of the four well-designed units offers two bedrooms and one full bath, featuring bright, west-facing living rooms that welcome afternoon light, and functional kitchens with adjacent dining areas. The building is thoughtfully laid out with mirror-image units, maximizing privacy and space. Each unit includes its own dedicated garage parking spot plus additional driveway parking, as well as individual storage spaces. A shared laundry area with coin-operated washer and dryer provides added convenience for tenants. This is a rare investment opportunity in a prime San Francisco location - perfect for owner-occupiers or savvy investors.
